items.title: Bitcoin Lender Ledn Moves US Clients Onshore With New Custody Accounts
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Lender Ledn Moves US Clients Onshore With New Custody Accounts Bitcoin lender Ledn launched a US custody account that lets clients hold bitcoin, gold, stablecoins and dollars, with no trading fees and a 0.5% spread. This post Bitcoin Lender Ledn Moves US Clients Onshore With New Custody Accounts first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts Coinkite published its full Coldcard postmortem, saying a five-year firmware flaw weakened wallet seeds and that about 242 customer accounts have reported losses. This post Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Anchorage Digital Sets Up Asset Manager to Offer Bitcoin Yield to Clients
items.description: Bitcoin Magazine Anchorage Digital Sets Up Asset Manager to Offer Bitcoin Yield to Clients Anchorage Digital is launching 61st Parallel Asset Management, a subsidiary expected to open by early December with a bitcoin-denominated fund that lets custody clients earn yield. This post Anchorage Digital Sets Up Asset Manager to Offer Bitcoin Yield to Clients first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years

items.description: The saga surrounding the ouster and return of Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang has become another reminder of how weak the bitcoin market currently is and how all the key price catalysts remain outside bitcoin and the crypto industry’s control.
